name: ferrifuzz-vscode
description: Syntax highlighting, completion and checks for ferrifuzz fuzzy-rule strings in Python, snippets for the ferrifuzz Python API, and a check that the selected interpreter can provide ferrifuzz completions.

ferrifuzz.interpreterCheck.enabled.description: Warn when a Python file imports ferrifuzz but the selected interpreter does not have ferrifuzz 0.2.0 or newer (needed for completions and hover docs).

ferrifuzz.ruleCompletion.enabled.description: Suggest variables, terms, hedges and keywords inside rule strings ("IF temp IS ..."), read from the Variables defined in the same file.

ferrifuzz.ruleDiagnostics.enabled.description: Warn about unknown terms, misspelled variables and inputs / outputs on the wrong side of THEN in rule strings added to a system in the same file.

scripts.test: npm run test:check && npm run test:rules && npm run test:extension
